JSSC Para Teacher JTAACCE Online Form 2026 (Postponed) – Full Details

Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has released the notification for the Post Of Para Teacher JTAACCE. This recruitment has been issued for 7299 posts. Online applying process for JSSC Para Teacher JTAACCE Recruitment 2026 will start from 31 July 2026 & the candidates can apply till 30 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for JSSC Para Teacher JTAACCE Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 31 July 2026
  • Last Date : 30 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 September 2026
  • Photo/ Sign Upload Last Date : 03 September 2026
  • Correction Date: 05-07 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, BC, EWS : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 50/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
